headline: Azurmane
title: Azurmane | Lightning Steed | Palworld Guide
video_script: Azurmane is an Electric Pal you can ride, and its partner skill is Plasma Dash, an air dash that lets you move at even higher speeds. At your base it generates electricity at level five. Wild Azurmane appear around levels sixty three to sixty six. Which Electric mount do you prefer? Comment below!

scenes.fact: Levels sixty three to sixty six

joke: Azurmane is fast enough to arrive before your loading screen ends.
description: Azurmane in Palworld 1.0: Electric Pal that can be ridden, with the Plasma Dash partner skill giving an Air Dash. Generating Electricity 5. Wild levels 63 to 66. Checked on Pindrop, palworld.gg and Pal Breed Calc in November 2026.
